injuries.longComment: Downs' season is over after he tore his ACL during Tuesday's practice session. The 23-year-old will now shift his focus to getting healthy, and he will look to make his NFL debut during the 2027 campaign.
injuries.shortComment: The Chiefs placed (Downs) knee on injured reserve Tuesday, Matt Derrick of ChiefsDigest.com reports.

injuries.longComment: Norman-Lott was placed on the active/PUP list ahead of training camp, and he did not appear in a preseason game as he continues to recover from a torn ACL that he suffered in October. The defensive lineman will now be forced to miss at least four contests to begin the regular season, and in his absence, rookie first-rounder Peter Woods will handle the primary reserve role at defensive tackle behind Chris Jones and Khyiris Tonga.
injuries.shortComment: Norman-Lott (knee) was moved to the reserve/PUP list by the Chiefs on Sunday.

injuries.longComment: Smith sustained a hamstring injury in Thursday's practice session and has promptly been transitioned to IR as he manages the issue. Running back Jaydn Ott has been signed to the active roster to be the No. 3 option behind Kenneth Walker and Emmett Johnson while Smith recovers.
injuries.shortComment: The Chiefs placed Smith (hamstring) on injured reserve Saturday.

injuries.longComment: The transaction frees up a spot on the 53-man roster for linebacker Cam Jones, who was signed off the practice squad. After dislocating his left ankle in the Chiefs' Oct. 4 win over the Raiders and requiring surgery, Thornton is facing an estimated recovery timeline of 3-to-4 months, which means that he'll likely be sidelined until at least Week 17 or 18 in a best-case scenario. While Thornton is out, the Chiefs are expected to lean on Jalen Royals and Cyrus Allen to handle more reps in three-receiver sets alongside starters Rashee Rice (hamstring) and Xavier Worthy.
injuries.shortComment: The Chiefs placed Thornton (ankle) on injured reserve Tuesday.

injuries.longComment: Holiday is dealing with an undisclosed injury, and he did not play during the preseason. The wide receiver will now be forced to miss the entire 2026 campaign while on IR, unless he is able to reach an injury settlement with Kansas City.
injuries.shortComment: Holiday (undisclosed) was placed on injured reserve by the Chiefs on Sunday.

injuries.longComment: Caldwell hyperextended his left knee during Wednesday's practice and was promptly waived with an injury designation. The wide receiver will now spend the entirety of the 2026 regular season on injured reserve unless he is waived with an injury settlement.
injuries.shortComment: Caldwell (knee) reverted to the Chiefs' injured reserve list Tuesday, Charles Goldman of AtoZSports.com reports.

injuries.longComment: Moore entered the league's concussion protocol during the Chiefs' Week 6 against the Chargers. He was not cleared to practice during Week 7 prep and will be sidelined for Sunday's contest, so Joshua Ezeudu will likely draw the start at right tackle. Moore's next opportunity to play is Week 8 against the Broncos on Nov. 1.
injuries.shortComment: Moore (concussion) has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Seahawks.

injuries.longComment: Though he had been on the Chiefs' 53-man roster all season, Simmons had yet to make his 2026 debut while working his way back from a bulging and herniated disc in his lower back. Simmons appeared to be making strides in his recovery after he returned to practice last week as a limited participant, but he downgraded to no participation Wednesday after head trainer Rick Burkholder said that the second-year left tackle "plateaued in the rehab process," per Nate Taylor of ESPN.com. As a result, the Chiefs have opted to deactivate Simmons, who won't be eligible to play until Week 11 versus the Cardinals. Undrafted rookie Kahlil Benson should continue to start at left tackle in Simmons' absence.
injuries.shortComment: The Chiefs placed Simmons (lower back) on injured reserve Thursday.

injuries.longComment: Waletzko did not get claimed after the Chiefs waived him with an undisclosed injury Thursday, and he's now in line to spend the entire 2026 on IR. He last suited up for a regular-season contest back in 2024 with the Cowboys.
injuries.shortComment: Waletzko (undisclosed) reverted from waivers to Kansas City's injured reserve list Friday, Aaron Wilson of KPRC 2 Houston reports.

injuries.shortComment: Nussmeier (coach's decision) is inactive as the emergency third quarterback for Sunday night's game against the Seahawks.
